a_missing_receipt_refuses: every condition reads a receipt this repository contains. If one is absent the rule RAISES rather than reporting not-fired, because silence and absence are different and only one is information.

bench.machine: Apple host CPU; receipt/header metadata only
bench.rule: no hardware measurement claim without hardware

claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement.

emitted_workunits.claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement. Does not produce DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE or PROTECTED_ABSOLUTE. SLEEPING physical work is never filled in with a synthetic result.
emitted_workunits.detail: the token DAG has no top-level slack, so the unused capacity multi-session execution proves exists must be inside kernel execution: occupancy, outstanding reads, independent accumulators
emitted_workunits.title: Probe kernel occupancy and memory-level parallelism

emitted_workunits.claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement. Does not produce DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE or PROTECTED_ABSOLUTE. SLEEPING physical work is never filled in with a synthetic result.
emitted_workunits.detail: the q2 and q4 matvec ladders are built and both paid. The DeltaNet state update, rearrange and gated norm are about 2.0 ms and have no ladder, so nobody knows what their arithmetic is spent on
emitted_workunits.title: Build the op-class ladder for the DeltaNet state kernel

emitted_workunits.claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement. Does not produce DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE or PROTECTED_ABSOLUTE. SLEEPING physical work is never filled in with a synthetic result.
emitted_workunits.detail: MLP_ALU_ROOFLINE.json carries the signature - production spread 1.696 against DeltaNet's 1.010 - and its median landed on the fast mode by luck. Other receipts taken at warmup 5 have not been checked
emitted_workunits.title: Audit every landed roofline receipt for bimodal arms

emitted_workunits.claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement. Does not produce DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE or PROTECTED_ABSOLUTE. SLEEPING physical work is never filled in with a synthetic result.
emitted_workunits.detail: the named suspect for projection error is the DENOMINATOR, not the kernel: counting DeltaNet's whole organ as q4 matvec already moved one projection by 25%. Per-kernel attribution has not been verified
emitted_workunits.title: Check whether the organ census attributes kernel time correctly

emitted_workunits.claim_boundary: Static sidecar artifact. No hardware measurement. Does not produce DIAGNOSTIC_RELATIVE or PROTECTED_ABSOLUTE. SLEEPING physical work is never filled in with a synthetic result.
emitted_workunits.detail: after perfect arithmetic removal the matvecs are 15.27 ms of pure streaming and 60 TPS needs 2.56 ms more, which can only come from bytes. Entropy coding cannot supply it at 1.87 bits per 2 stored and 93.5% independent information; this is information elimination
emitted_workunits.title: Eliminate 16.8% of the matvec weight bytes

discriminators_that_killed_fastest: an output comparison inside the harness - it caught two candidates that were fast and returned garbage, before either left the probe
a matched control arm held across runs - arm_a holding to 0.05% is what licensed attributing a production change to anything else
an archived negative control replayed against a new judge - it caught a judge keyed on the wrong flag inside a minute
kernel_changes_that_usually_fail: removing one op class when four share the cost - twice now
measurements_that_mislead: a first-measured arm at low warmup: bimodal, median is a coin flip
a synthetic dyadic input: it made bit-identity an artifact
an isolated organ number projected onto the graph: wrong in both directions across three observations
a byte count times an organ average rate: byte classes differ
oracle_controls_that_saved_time: arm_a as the arithmetic-free floor: it bounded an entire school in one number rather than one candidate at a time
ratios_that_transfer: arm_a over production, which held to 0.15% between a contaminated window and a protected lease
meta_policy.this_is_not_a_law: these are observations from one body on one machine over one campaign. They are priors for choosing the next experiment, not conclusions to cite as evidence.

rules.bought_by: G009 multi-session capacity, G082 token DAG
rules.if: aggregate throughput rises with independent sessions AND single-session semantics are unchanged
rules.observation: 11 of 11 token edges are true dependencies
rules.reopen: a graph with a genuinely independent top-level region
rules.then: raise the prior on latency hiding and insufficient independent work; look INSIDE kernels

rules.emits_nothing_because: this rule's action is a REFUSAL, already enforced in frontiers._item. A rule that suppresses work must not also generate work - that would be the busywork it exists to prevent.
rules.if: the token DAG has zero overlapable top-level work
rules.reopen: speculative drafting or a second sequence adds an independent top-level region
rules.then: suppress every top-level reordering hypothesis at proposal time

rules.bought_by: the dequant hoist and fold_addqx, which both attacked a 1.8% class and bought nothing
rules.if: a kernel's arithmetic splits across classes with no class above 50%
rules.observation: largest op class is 41.9% of the arithmetic; no class dominates
rules.reopen: a different kernel; the split is kernel-specific and the q4 ladder had to be measured separately
rules.then: refuse to attack one class before the split is measured; the expected win from removing one is the class's share, not the whole span

rules.bought_by: G092, recorded wrong twice before warmup was found
rules.if: an arm's slowest rep exceeds its fastest by more than 10%
rules.observation: 3 readings of one candidate, 2 of them wrong
rules.reopen: never; this is an instrument property, not a model property
rules.then: refuse the measurement; its median is a coin flip between modes, not a value

rules.bought_by: two under-predictions that became a claimed lower bound, then one over-prediction that falsified it
rules.if: an isolated organ measurement is used to project a graph-level win
rules.observation: isolated projection over-predicted at 0.7051x after under-predicting twice
rules.reopen: a mechanism explaining the direction would make it a bound again; none is established
rules.then: label it an estimate in BOTH directions; do not call it a bound

rules.bought_by: arm_a bounding the whole decode-arithmetic school at 52 TPS
rules.if: a school's perfect success does not reach the target
rules.observation: perfect arithmetic removal reaches 52.008 TPS, 2.561 ms short of 60
rules.reopen: a change that moves arm_a itself - fewer bytes changes the streaming floor the ceiling is computed from
rules.then: the school must not be the only thing running; open a second class in parallel rather than after

rules_emit_through_the_frontier_layer: units are built with frontiers._item, so a rule cannot emit work the frontier layer would itself refuse - including work belonging to a school an emitted scar has already closed.
